name: to teach
title: to-teach.ai
shortDescription: to teach is an AI-powered educational tool designed to assist teachers in planning lessons, creating exercises, and generating worksheets. It aligns with educational curriculums, providing materials and solutions to enhance teaching efficiency. For example, a teacher can use to teach to create up to 200 exercises, 50 worksheets, and 25 lesson plans monthly, significantly reducing preparation time.
pros: Offers scalable plans for different needs
cons: Could be complex for tech-averse users
